# National Air and Space Museum

> The National Air and Space Museum preserves and shares the history of aviation and space exploration through world-class collections, exhibitions, and educational programs across two locations in Washington, DC and Chantilly, VA.

The museum operates two major facilities: the main location on the National Mall in Washington, DC, and the Steven F. Udvar-Hazy Center near Dulles Airport in Chantilly, VA. Both locations offer free admission with timed-entry passes and feature iconic aircraft and spacecraft including the Space Shuttle Discovery, Concorde, and Apollo 11 Command Module Columbia.

## Key Topics

- Space Shuttle Discovery
- Apollo program
- Wright Brothers
- Concorde
- Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird
- Space exploration
- Aviation history
- Timed-entry passes
- Steven F. Udvar-Hazy Center
- IMAX and planetarium
- Collections database
- Educational programs
- Field trips
- Group visits
- Smithsonian Institution

## Plan Your Visit

- [Visit the National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/visit): Museum visit guide for two locations in DC and Chantilly, VA.
- [Visit the Museum in DC, Free Timed-Entry Passes Required](https://airandspace.si.edu/visit/museum-dc): DC location visitor information with free timed-entry passes required.
- [Steven F. Udvar-Hazy Center | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/visit/udvar-hazy-center): Udvar-Hazy Center visitor guide featuring Space Shuttle Discovery, Concorde.
- [Plan a group visit | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/visit/group-visit): Group visit planning guide for DC and Chantilly locations.
- [IMAX Theaters and Planetarium | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/whats-on/imax-theaters-and-planetarium): IMAX and planetarium information with showtimes and tickets.

## Exhibitions & Events

- [Homepage | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu): National Air and Space Museum homepage with visitor info, exhibitions, collections.
- [What's On | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/whats-on): Events, exhibitions, IMAX, planetarium, and programs calendar.

## Explore Collections & Research

- [Explore | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/explore): Museum explore hub for collections, stories, and aviation/space topics.
- [Collections | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/explore/collections): Searchable database of 29,000+ air and space artifacts and photographs.
- [All Topics | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/explore/topics): Topic directory for Apollo, Gemini, Mercury, Space Shuttle programs.
- [Stories | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/explore/stories): Editorial stories on aviation history, space exploration, Tuskegee Airmen.
- [For Researchers | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/explore/researchers): Research resources, archives, fellowships, and planetary science data.

## Education & Learning

- [Learn | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/learn): Educational hub with videos, activities, STEM resources for all learners.
- [Plan a Field Trip | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/learn/plan-field-trip): Field trip planning guide for free year-round visits to both locations.
- [Plan a Field Trip | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/learn/field-trip): Field trip planning with logistics, parking, dining options.
- [Programs | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/learn/programs): Educational programs, demonstrations, planetarium shows for students.
- [Educator Professional Development | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/learn/professional-development): Teacher training, STEAM resources, inquiry-based classroom activities.

## Optional

- [On Demand | National Air and Space Museum](https://airandspace.si.edu/explore/on-demand): On-demand videos on space exploration and aviation history.
